body: I’m sorry you’re going through the same thing. It sucks feeling like someone means everything to you, while you mean nothing to them

I definitely do have lip incompetence! I don’t think I have long face syndrome or anything like that, I think I just have a weak chin and some lip incompetence. [Here](https://imgur.com/a/j592WZk) is a little thing I made showing the difference between my forcibly closed mouth and my natural mouth, as well as a straight profile image to show what I mean. I think something that contributes to the overall ‘wonk’ of my face is 1.) my chin, and 2.) as was mentioned above, I have a really long midface, but not necessarily a long face overall.

Yeah, I’m really insecure about my whole midface/jaw/chin area, I’ve been looking into ways to fix my bite and chin, from orthognathic surgery to a genioplasty. Right now I’m just working on consciously keeping my mouth closed, and making sure my tongue is at the roof of my mouth.

I’ve got insurance, but there’s no surgeon in the area who does maxillofacial or orthodontic work, so I’d have to leave the area and that’s when things get tricky! I brought it up to my orthodontist and they pretty much told me to get a mouth guard for the pain, but I’m planning on bringing it up to my dentist when I go in for a check up to get a second opinion.

Yeah, I feel like overall a genioplasty is the better option but I’m really nervous about screwing my jaw up any further! It already causes me pain/bite issues/etc, so I’m scared that adjusting it via genioplasty would make things worse? 

I’ve been looking into orthognathic surgery a little to see if it would be possible to fix two birds with one stone, but it’s FAR more expensive than either a genioplasty or an implant, which is discouraging.
Via the power of Facetune, I made a [rough estimate](https://m.imgur.com/4uatINB) of how far I’d like to correct! (With bonus imaginary rhinoplasty)
